title: Tribal court opinion (table row)
description: One row of research/tribal-court-opinions/opinions.csv: a tribal court opinion in a Caselaw Access Project reporter, with the private copy the site serves as its own page (decision record 0047). Built by scripts/caselaw/tribal_court_opinions.py from the reporters, courts and topics in research/tribal-court-opinions/sources.yaml; the site reads it (site/src/lib/server/tribal-court-opinions.ts). Every cell is text and an empty cell is left out before checking, so 'required' means the cell may not be empty.

case_id.description: The Caselaw Access Project's id for the case.

citation.description: Volume, reporter and first page, for example '1 Navajo Rptr. 1'.

other_citations.description: Other reporters' citations, separated by semicolons.

decision_date.description: As the reporter gives it; some give only the year or the year and month.

nations.description: Ids of Tribe profiles in content/tribes/ (scripts/validate_records.py checks they exist).

words.description: Length of the opinion in words.

topics.description: Tags from sources.yaml for words the opinion mentions; they say the words appear, not what it decides.

copy_key.description: The opinion's key in the private bucket: reporter, volume and case file.

volume_key.description: The capture of the whole volume.

link.description: The opinion on the Caselaw Access Project's site.
